bilibili.rename_limit: Current tendency: no coin charge and once in 7 days (rollout); older sources say 6 coins, first change free
notes: Sources give 3–16, 2–30 and 2–20. Following the research's tendency, display a maximum of 16; the minimum is unconfirmed.
CJK counting, spaces and some symbols are unconfirmed. Conflicting and unknown rules only produce warnings.
All sources come from docs/platform_naming_rules.md; no additional online research was used.

sources.title: Baidu Zhidao: conflicting nickname length answers
Baidu Experience: customer support rules, paraphrased
User video: one change in 7 days

douyin.rename_limit: Tendency: twice a day, four times in 30 days; verified accounts may require review
notes: Sources give limits of 20, 30 and 2–24. Display 20 following the research's tendency, without blocking on this basis.
The research leans toward unique names, but this has not been officially confirmed.
Character counting and special symbols are unconfirmed. The explicitly rejected claim about TikTok's 30-day rename interval was not adopted.

sources.title: Douyin User Agreement (no definitive length or uniqueness rule)

xiaohongshu.rename_limit: Tendency: once in 30 days; claims of 7 days and other cooldowns are unconfirmed
notes: Recent sources suggest minima of 2–3 and maxima of 16–20, with no single conclusion. Display the wider 2–20 range as conflicting and do not block on it.
Nickname uniqueness is supported only by third parties and needs testing; it is not an official conclusion.
Some symbols may be allowed, but the exact list was not found. @<>/ appeared only in search snippets and were not adopted as explicit restrictions.

weixin_channels.rename_limit: Tendency: five changes per year, reset on January 1; verification may need to be cancelled first
notes: Uniqueness is supported by official terms and user testing. unique.confidence is marked user_tested as requested.
Underscores, hyphens, middle dots and emoji are treated as forbidden under the official ban on special symbols. This symbol list is an inference; spaces remain unknown without a clear answer.
The official 3–30 rule, with CJK characters counting as two, is used for format checks. Creating and renaming may have different practical limits.
Older sources give two changes, conflicting with the newer official limit of five. This does not affect format validation.

sources.title: WeChat official community: length, characters and uniqueness
WeChat official community: five changes per year
User test: existing name reported as taken (local research record)

github.rename_limit: No official frequency limit listed; community says no strict limit. Old names are usually released immediately, with some retired namespace exceptions
notes: Only ASCII letters, digits and single hyphens are checked. GitHub display names are outside this tool's scope.
No complete official list of reserved words was found, so no invented restrictions are added.

sources.title: GitHub: username considerations for external authentication

x.rename_limit: Changes are allowed at any time, with no official count limit listed. Old names are usually released immediately; suspended or deactivated names are not released immediately
notes: Only handles are collected; duplicate display names are not validated.
Use the research's 4–15 tendency. English 'more than 4' conflicts with German 4–15, so names below that minimum only get an unknown warning; the explicit official maximum of 15 still blocks.
Restricted uses of X, Admin and Twitter are unconfirmed and require platform confirmation. Names containing the letter x are not automatically rejected.
Underscores may appear at either end. No additional restriction on consecutive underscores was found, so none is added.
